assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 232% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, totaling 4,628 cases this year compared to 1,544 in the same period last year.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 533% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, totaling 1,202 cases this year compared to 1,273 in the same period last year.
West Nile virus cases in the US are peaking with a 1,762% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, totaling 1,611 cases this year compared to 2,619 in the same period last year.
Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are peaking with sustained high-level transmission reported by WHO, including 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths as of November 3, 2026.
Influenza activity is peaking with a 18% increase in global flu test positivity and 76% rise in US hospital admissions compared to the previous month.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are rising with a 79% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, totaling 7,692 cases this year compared to 8,313 in the same period last year.
Mpox cases in the US are rising with a 47% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, totaling 1,434 cases this year compared to 2,018 in the same period last year.
Malaria cases in the US are rising with a 59% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, totaling 1,130 cases this year compared to 1,400 in the same period last year.
RSV activity is rising globally and in the US, with test positivity increasing by 62% monthly and hospital admissions up 47% monthly.
Pertussis cases in the US are rising, with reported cases up 48% over the past 8 months and annual cases exceeding last year's total.
US COVID-19 hospital admissions are at baseline levels, with a 10% monthly increase from the previous month.
Marburg virus disease activity is falling, with Wikipedia readership at the 57th percentile of the past year.
Chikungunya cases in the US are at baseline, with a slight decrease in weekly reports over the past 8 months.
Norovirus activity is at baseline, with Wikipedia readership at the 30th percentile of the past year.
Avian influenza (H5N1) activity is at baseline, with Wikipedia readership at the 31st percentile of the past year.
